pages.text: Puts a secret into your vault.

A secret with the same name is replaced. The type of the secret is the type of $(1)value$(). A vault holds up to 128 secrets of up to 2000 characters. With $(1)persistent$() TRUE, the secret is also stored in your persistent vault, which must be open (VAULT_NOT_OPEN otherwise). The cursor waits while your game encrypts the file.

$(li)$(1)name$() STRING: the name of the secret$(li)$(1)value$() BOOLEAN, INTEGER, FLOAT, CHAR, STRING or TIME: the value$(li)$(1)persistent$() BOOLEAN: also store it in the persistent vault (optional, default FALSE)$(li)no results
$(1)CALL c0de/security/SET_SECRET$(br)  PARAMETER name "apiKey" ;$(br)  PARAMETER value key ;$(br)  PARAMETER persistent TRUE ;$()
